study: Single-video exploratory evaluation, paper-style 1s and study-adapted 3s confirmation, no tuning

model.selection: Only available completed combined-data plain baseline; validation-selected best checkpoint

limits: OpenCV MOG2 approximates paper background modelling
Generic flame/smoke alarms before visible flame are not necessarily false alarms; smoke onset is unknown
Alarm persistence is distinct from observed boxes; no carried box is scored as a current detection
Fire-box presence is not spatially validated on unannotated frames.
Sampled first correct hits are not exact first-correct alarm times.
One previously examined fire clip cannot establish generalization or false alarms/hour on no-fire videos.
No ten-second physical-danger rule is implemented or validated.
